dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Because this occurs, that too must...

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: We need not say more. Knowledge and execution are closely linked anyway. Well then, let's play.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we will meet again. And when that happens, let's have a good match of wits and wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: I see, I see... Beating you has provided me with significant inspiration for my research.

dialogues.speaker: Railah
dialogues.text: Huh. So that's how it is... I may have lost, but my research has benefited greatly.
